title: Telegram Agentic AI Assistant Architecture
content: The Telegram Agentic AI Assistant is built using LangGraph stateful workflow architecture. It coordinates query analysis, decision making, dynamic routing, LLM reasoning, RAG knowledge retrieval, and tool execution.

title: Project 6 System Features and Capabilities
content: Project 6 features a multi-branch routing agent capable of performing arithmetic calculations via the Calculator Tool, retrieving project documentation via the ChromaDB RAG engine, and answering complex conceptual queries using LLM reasoning.

title: Supported Bot Commands and Usage Guidelines
content: The Telegram bot supports conversational queries, /start for onboarding, /help for feature listings, /status for agent health, and automated query routing across LLM, RAG, and Tool subsystems.

title: Data Governance and Security Policies
content: The Telegram Agent adheres to strict security policies: no API keys or internal tracebacks are exposed to users, all calculations are parsed securely via AST, and all outputs undergo result normalization and validation prior to delivery.

title: Knowledge Base Querying Specifications
content: When a user asks about project specifications, architecture details, internal policies, or system documentation, the agent routes the query to the RAG Knowledge subsystem for retrieval-grounded answers.
